```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("R/helpers.R")
lab_email <- "petya.apostolova@unibas.ch"

# ---- Map --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Address shown on the Google map (any text Google Maps can search for works:
# a street address, a building name, or "47.5605,7.5833" coordinates).
map_query <- "Department of Biomedicine, Hebelstrasse 20, 4031 Basel, Switzerland"

google_map <- function(query, zoom = 16) {
  q <- utils::URLencode(query, reserved = TRUE)
  tagList(
    tags$iframe(class = "map",
                src = paste0("https://www.google.com/maps?q=", q, "&z=", zoom, "&output=embed"),
                loading = "lazy", referrerpolicy = "no-referrer-when-downgrade",
                title = paste("Map:", query), allowfullscreen = NA),
    p(class = "map-link",
      a(href = paste0("https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=", q),
        target = "_blank", rel = "noopener", "Open in Google Maps"))
  )
}

```
